name: Exp_ColorMETRO_Duplex
summary: This EA is a duplex (bi-directional) trading system based on the ColorMETRO momentum indicator. It opens trades in both directions when the indicator's color changes signal momentum shifts, operating on dual signal logic for long and short entries.
summary_zh: 该EA是基于ColorMETRO动量指标的双向交易系统。当指标颜色变化发出动量转向信号时，EA在两个方向上开仓交易，采用双信号逻辑进行多头和空头入场。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用ColorMETRO动量指标作为核心信号源，通过指标颜色变化判断动量方向的转换。入场条件为ColorMETRO指标颜色从一种状态切换到另一种状态时，分别触发多头或空头入场信号。作为Duplex（双向）系统，EA可同时在两个方向上捕捉信号，具备做多和做空的独立逻辑。出场条件依赖于指标的反向信号或内置的止损/止盈机制。仓位管理通过手数参数控制，但具体是否包含资金管理逻辑取决于参数配置。整体策略以动量跟随为核心，在指标确认趋势转向时进场，在动量消退或反转时离场。
strategy_analysis_en: The EA uses the ColorMETRO momentum indicator as its core signal source, determining momentum direction shifts through indicator color changes. Entry conditions are triggered when the ColorMETRO indicator switches from one color state to another, generating long or short entry signals respectively. As a Duplex (bi-directional) system, the EA can capture signals in both directions with independent long and short logic. Exit conditions rely on the indicator's reverse signal or built-in stop-loss/take-profit mechanisms. Position sizing is controlled through lot size parameters, though whether money management logic is included depends on parameter configuration. The overall strategy centers on momentum following, entering when the indicator confirms a trend shift and exiting when momentum fades or reverses.

parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 基于动量指标的趋势跟随逻辑清晰，信号直观
Duplex双向交易设计能同时捕捉上涨和下跌动量
使用ColorMETRO指标颜色变化作为信号，减少了主观判断的干扰
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic based on momentum indicator with intuitive signals
Duplex bi-directional design captures both upward and downward momentum
Using ColorMETRO color changes as signals reduces subjective judgment interference
cons: 动量指标在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致反复亏损
双向交易在没有趋势的横盘市场中可能同时触发多空信号造成对冲损失
缺乏明确的资金管理和仓位递进机制，固定手数交易风险较大
cons_en: Momentum indicators easily generate frequent false signals in ranging markets causing repeated losses
Bi-directional trading may trigger both long and short signals simultaneously in sideways markets causing hedging losses
Lacks explicit money management and progressive position sizing; fixed lot trading carries significant risk
improvements: 增加震荡市过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在无趋势时暂停交易减少虚假信号
引入动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和ATR自动调整手数大小
improvements_en: Add a ranging market filter (such as ADX or volatility indicator) to pause trading during trendless periods and reduce false signals
Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance and ATR

risk_points: 动量指标在横盘市中信号频繁翻转可能造成连续亏损
固定手数交易缺乏根据账户风险动态调整的机制
risk_points_en: Momentum indicator frequent signal flips in sideways markets may cause consecutive losses
Fixed lot trading lacks dynamic adjustment mechanism based on account risk
